blocks.text: COTABATO CITY, BARMM, Philippines — A majority coalition in the Bangsamoro Parliament has secured the backing of all five provincial governors in the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) and Moro National Liberation Front (MNLF) chair Nur Misuari, ahead of the convening of the regional legislature on Oct. 30. In a joint statement released Friday, BARMM interim Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua and the provincial governors said the majority coalition is already in place, with its formal establishment as the Government of the Day to follow the election of the chief minister. “Let us be clear.
